cited.quote: the monthly pension has been enhanced from Rs.3,000/- to Rs.4,000/- under this scheme

rationale: C1 reports that in 2021-2022 the monthly pension for retired village temple poosaris aged 60 or more was raised from Rs.3,000 to Rs.4,000. This matches the promised amounts and age. Only the year span is given, so the date is approximate.

cited.quote: In the year 2023-2024 it has been expanded to 300 persons by incurring an expenditure of Rs.75 lakhs

rationale: Extracts show only a Rameswaram to Kasi group pilgrimage and Manasarovar/Muktinath grants. None shows the promised choice among Rameswaram, Kedarnath, Badrinath, Tirupathi, Puri with up to Rs.25,000 for 25 beneficiaries. Related activity only.

cited.quote: The Government have sanctioned Rs.1.52 Crore every year for conducting job fairs

rationale: Extracts cover job fairs, a private job portal, sports quota and teacher recruitment rule changes. None shows an official step to fill unfilled vacancies with the promised number of youngsters.

cited.quote: orders have been issued for formation of an Advisory committee to explore solutions

rationale: C1, C3 and C4 show only a state advisory committee exploring citizenship, and C2 lists its proposals. No extract shows a formal step urging the Union government (letter, resolution) on citizenship legislation.

cited.quote: Work order have been issued for 40 works and are in progress.

rationale: C3 shows work orders issued for water supply works in corporations and municipalities under AMRUT 2.0 and tenders invited for the rest, but works are in progress, not complete for all households. C1 is a budget plan only.

cited.quote: As on date, 6 weaving sheds are operational with 135 handlooms, providing employment to 500 persons.
12 have been completed, and 11 sheds are currently operational

rationale: C2 (2024-01-04) shows the park partly operating with 6 sheds; C1 shows 11 sheds operating, with the effluent plant still under construction. Operations have begun but at far below the benefit scale of about 25,000 weavers. Date is the first report of operation.

cited.quote: which has been approved by the Government in January 2025

rationale: C2 shows an approved parking policy and a pilot parking management plan for Anna Nagar, which is a policy step rather than building multi-level parking. C1, C4 and C5 concern data centres or EV charging, not multi-level parking facilities.
No extract concerns the girivalam path in Thiruvannamalai; they cover bridges, street lights, a forest declaration, bypass lists and hospital buildings.

cited.quote: This enables to monitor the formation and functioning of internal committees in all workplaces.
Notification have been issued in Newspapers by the District Collector directing all offices

rationale: Directional. C2 reports a web portal dated 14.08.2024 to monitor formation of internal committees in all workplaces, and C3 reports Collector notifications directing all offices to set them up. These are dedicated measures on the subject. Earlier dates are not shown.
No extract concerns a review of rents or new rent slabs for corporation or municipality shops. C1 and C3 are audit findings on tax and lease collection; others are unrelated.
No extract shows the state pressing the Union government on the income ceiling (creamy layer) for backward classes. Extracts mention income ceilings only for state scholarship and incentive schemes.
Extracts discuss CETPs, their funding and Zero Liquid Discharge sanctions, but none shows any subsidised electricity for the CETPs.

C2 shows the state urging the Union on a caste census and reservation powers, but no extract shows a formal step urging equal authority for the National Commission for Backward Classes. Other extracts concern the state commission.

cited.quote: dated 16.08.2023 and 170 pattas were issued

rationale: C3 reports Natham settlement completed in Thirubuvanam village by a GO dated 16.08.2023 with 170 pattas issued, and further settlements taken up. Settlement work was ongoing earlier; scope is not statewide, so the match is approximate.

cited.quote: permission to start 11 Paramedical Courses (Certificate Course-08, Diploma Course-02 and Degree Course-01)
Starting of 9 B.Sc. Allied Health Science Courses with an annual intake of 10 seats each

rationale: C1 is a GO dated 2024-10-18 permitting 11 new paramedical courses; C2 is a GO of 2024-11-20 permitting 9 B.Sc. allied health courses. Both introduce paramedical courses. Earliest shown is C1.

cited.quote: have been completed and the remaining works are in progress

rationale: C1 reports 18 bypasses taken up in three years, six completed and the rest in progress, with more taken up in 2024-25. Construction has begun but is not complete. The date is only the year of the report; no GO date is shown.

cited.quote: Climate Change and Forests (FR.5) Department, dated 10.10.2023
Tamil Nadu Power Fences (Registration and Regulation) Rules, 2023 regulating the erection of power fences

rationale: Directional. C4 refers to GO (D) No.205 dated 10.10.2023 sanctioning a real time monitoring system for elephant herds to address human-elephant conflict, with a 2024 authorization; C2 lists power fence rules and committees. These are dedicated measures.

cited.quote: Erection of Steel wire rope fence at a distance of 10.00 km for mitigation of Human-Elephant conflict
Regular patrolling by Anti-poaching watchers have been carried out

rationale: Directional. C5 is a GO dated 2025-02-06 sanctioning a 10 km steel wire rope fence against human-elephant conflict, a barrier measure. C1 lists anti-depredation squads and patrolling. Earliest dated official step shown is C5.

cited.quote: Construction work is in progress and the facilities will be put to public use soon
Olympic Academies are set up in Chennai, Tiruchirappalli, Madurai and The Nilgiris

rationale: C1 shows academies in Tiruchirappalli, Madurai and the Nilgiris being built with costs fixed and work in progress, and only Chennai housed in an existing building (C2). Four zones are identified but not all operational. No GO date shown.

cited.quote: Digitization of family cards / beneficiary databases.
The State Public Distribution System has been fully computerised

rationale: C1 (2022 policy note) describes the end to end computerisation project, and C2 (2024) states the system has been fully computerised, with online applications and online supply chain. No GO date shown, so the year of the first report is used.
